report:
Findings: There is no evidence of knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Normal tibiofemoral articular cartilage. Mild - moderate thinning and fraying of the patellofemoral articular cartilage is demonstrated.  A 15 mm ganglion is noted in the popliteal soft tissues.  
Conclusion: No evidence of meniscal injury. No significant tibiofemoral degeneration. Mild - moderate patellofemoral degenerate change noted.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Injury while playing tennis [DATE], medial knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex predominantly horizontal tear of the body and posterior horn with femoral and tibial extension and intrameniscal cyst formation. There is mild meniscal extrusion. 
Medial compartment cartilage: Full thickness fissuring the central weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Grade 1 sprain.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 4 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Grade 1 strain of the soleus and lateral head of the gastrocnemius. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.


IMPRESSION:

1. Complex predominantly horizontal tear of the medial meniscus with femoral and tibial extension as well as intrameniscal cyst formation.

2. Grade 1 strain of the soleus and lateral head of the gastrocnemius.

3. Full-thickness chondral fissuring the central weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS, SG T1W

> Some spur formation  of femoral trochlea and wearing of articular cartilage , reflecting grade 3 chondromalacia..
   Osteophyte of patella with wearing of articular carilage and tiny subchondral cysts, reflecting grade 3-4 chondromalacia.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis; small Baker's cyst.
> Focal faint hyperintensity area in posterior metaphysis of right distal femur on F/S T2WI (Srs/Img: [ID].
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, R/O mild paratendinits.
> Mild interstitial increased signal intensity of  iliotibial band and distal bicep tendon and patellar tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of tendinosis.
> Subcutaneous infiltration over anterior aspect of right  knee.
> Laxity of lateral patellar retinacululm
Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of right knee, more prominent at patellofemoral joint, with grade 3-4 chondromalacia.
2. Mild synovitis of right knee with suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae and small Baker's cyst.
3. Tendinosis of Iliotibial band and distal bicep tendon and patellar tendon; laxity of lateral patellar retinacululm
4. Mild paratendinitis of ped anserinus.
5. R/O red bone marrow island in right distal femur  (Srs/Img: [ID] .
6. Subcutaneous infiltration over anterior aspect of right  knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Small medial and lateral compartment marginal osteophytes.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion with synovial proliferation. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate, multilobulated Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness chondrosis along the weightbearing medial femoral condyle and tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness chondrosis along the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness chondrosis along the lateral patellar facet extending to the median ridge with focal subchondral bone marrow edema at the lateral facet/median ridge junction. Low-grade, partial thickness chondrosis along the medial patellar facet. Areas of full-thickness chondrosis along the medial and central trochlea with low-grade, partial thickness chondrosis along the lateral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Tricompartmental osteoarthritis, most advanced in the patellofemoral compartment.

2. Small knee joint effusion with synovial proliferation and a moderate, multilobulated Baker's cyst.

In the medial compartment, there is horizontal tear at the  body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is suspected small radial free edge tear at the body of the lateral meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present.  
 There is tendinopathy with partial tear and associated intratendinous cyst (intact6*intact6*2 cm) of the left semimembranosus tendon, at and below the knee joint line. There are cortical erosions with rective marrow edema and cystic changes at the posteromedial tibial plateau.  
 Low grade myotendinous strain of the semimembranosus muscle (about 4.5 cm in length) is also identified.  Horizontal tear at the  body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. 
  Suspected small radial free edge tear at the body of the lateral meniscus. 
  Tendinopathy with partial tear and associated intratendinous cyst (intact6*intact6*2 cm) of the left semimembranosus tendon, at and below the knee joint line. (note: cortical erosions with rective marrow edema and cystic changes at the posteromedial tibial plateau)  
  Low grade myotendinous strain of the semimembranosus muscle (about 4.5 cm in length).

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Radiographs showing possible bone lesion in the right lateral proximal tibia/fibula, prior arthroscopy
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.2 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol. Bulky tricompartmental marginal osteophytes.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Severe osteoarthritis at the proximal tibiofibular joint.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Several intraarticular loose bodies measuring up to 16 mm in the suprapatellar recess. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex macerated tear of the medial meniscal body and posterior horn with moderate extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is a full-thickness chondrosis throughout the weightbearing and nonweightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle with subchondral marrow edema. Additional full thickness chondrosis in the posterior and peripheral aspect of the medial tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Complex macerated tear of the anterior root, anterior horn, body, posterior root, and posterior horn with severe extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is a full-thickness chondrosis in the central weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and lateral plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Large areas of full-thickness cartilage loss in the lateral patellar facet and median ridge with subchondral marrow edema and cystic changes. Areas of full thickness fissuring the lateral trochlea with subchondral cystic changes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Chronic full thickness tear
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Chronic full thickness tear

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Bowed from medial compartment pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Bowed from lateral compartment pathology
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Severe tricompartmental knee osteoarthritis.

2. Complex macerated tears of the medial and lateral menisci.

3. Chronic full-thickness tears of the ACL and PCL.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Four-month history of bilateral knee pain. Patient with history of intense walking. [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Small oblique undersurface tear posterior horn medial meniscus. No meniscal extrusion or displaced fragment.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High grade partial thickness cartilage loss along the medial patellar facet and median ridge with superimposed full-thickness fissuring at the median ridge and mild subchondral marrow edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Oblique undersurface tear posterior horn medial meniscus without extrusion or displaced fragment.
2.	Patellofemoral compartment chondrosis as described.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Légère arthrose du compartiment médial avec petits ostéophytes marginaux et chondropatie modérée des surfaces portantes. Chondropathie globale légère à modérée du compartiment fémoro-patellaire et du compartiment latéral avec des foyers retardés de chondropathie sévère impliquant la face portante et postérieure du condyle fémoral latéral, la trochlée fémorale médiale, moins l'apex patellaire avec une fissuration profonde et un léger œdème osseux réactionnel associé.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Par ailleurs normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : Le ligament collatéral latéral est intact. Il y a une déchirure partielle proximale modérée du tendon du poplité avec une tendinose sous-jacente.

Ménisque médial : Changements dégénératifs du signal sans déchirure significative évidente.
Ménisque latéral : Déchirure horizontale oblique impliquant la corne postérieure et le corps avec une petite composante radiale à l'apex du corps.

Tendons extenseurs : Normaux.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normales.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-latéral et postérieur : Normal.

Épanchement articulaire : Pas de liquide significatif.
Kyste de Baker : Petit kyste de Baker non compliqué.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Aucune.

CONCLUSION :
Changements dégénératifs tricompartimentaux tels que décrits avec des foyers de chondropatie sévère impliquant le condyle fémoral latéral, la trochlée médiale et l'apex patellaire.
Déchirure horizontale oblique du ménisque latéral.
Déchirure partielle proximale modérée du tendon du poplité.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı orta derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Suprapateller resesteki sinovyal (kısmen lipomatö özellikteki) villpnodüler proliferasyon lipoma arboresens ile uyumlu. Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal eklemde en belirgin ve tam kat eklem kıkırdağı kaybına eşlik eden subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler-fibrokistik değişikliklerin yanı sıra marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Diz ekleminin medyalindeki iç yan bağ dış yüzeyi komşuluğundaki 4 cm çaplı 6 mm kalınlıktaki lobüle konturlu septasyonlar içeren muhtemel kistik lezyon gangliyon kistini telkin ediyor. Lateral menisküs dejenerasyonu yırtık biçiminde eklem yüzeylerine uzanmıyor. Medyal menisküs medyale 5 mm ekstrüde ve arka boynuz-gövdesindeki dejenerasyon üst ve alt eklem yüzeylerine uzanan yırtık bileşenleri olan kompleks yırtıklar ile birlikte. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküste kova sapı yırtığı izlenmiştir.Medial menisküs diz eklem mesafesinden 4.5 mm mediale ekstrüdedir. Menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon, serbest kenarda horizontal yırtık izlemiştir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Anterior çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyona sekonder kalınlaşma ve sinyal artışı izlenmiştir.Medial kollateral ligamanda periligamentöz ödem izlenmiştir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlenmektedir.Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yapı köşelerde milimetrik osteofitik sivrileşme izlenmiştir. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda incelme ve destrüksiyon izlenmektedir.Popliteal fossada 2.5x1 cm boyutlu Baker kisti izlenmiştir. SONUÇ: Gonartroz.Medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon ve grade II meniskopati.Lateral menisküste kova sapı yırtığı.Anterior çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon.Medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain.Suprapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit.
